note: 题目内容全部在这个文件里。要改题目、改阶梯档位、改研究方向，直接改这里，界面会跟着变，不用动代码。字符串都是 {zh, en} 形式，界面右上角可切语言。

intro.zh: 下面是一组选择题，大约 15 分钟。没有标准答案——我们要测的是你本人在「让 agent 自己跑 / 停下来 / 来问你」之间怎么权衡。请按你真实的直觉选。
intro.en: A set of choice questions, about 15 minutes. There are no right answers — we are measuring how you personally trade off letting an agent run, stopping it, or having it ask you. Answer on instinct.

prompt.zh: agent 在某个节点拿不准要不要继续。它可以自己拍板（省得烦你），但万一判错，会白白花掉一部分探索预算。下面每一行，请选你更愿意的做法。
prompt.en: The agent is unsure whether to continue at a node. It can decide alone (and not bother you), but if it decides wrong, part of the exploration budget is wasted. For each row, pick what you would rather have happen.

optionB.en: Interrupt you now for one confirmation

optionA.zh: 让 agent 自己决定（平均会白花约 5% 的探索预算）
optionA.en: Let the agent decide (wastes ~5% of the budget on average)

optionA.zh: 让 agent 自己决定（平均会白花约 10% 的探索预算）
optionA.en: Let the agent decide (wastes ~10% of the budget on average)

optionA.en: Let the agent decide (wastes ~20% of the budget on average)

sections.mapping: WTP 价格表读法：第一次翻转把 λ 夹进 [上一行, 本行] 区间，点估计取区间中点（MPL 标准，Holt & Laury 2002 / NBER w30433）。闸门侧 λ₀ 为该中点到响应区 [0.35,1.05] 的仿射放置（PROVISIONAL），区间与中点均保留在导出里。

rationale_prompt.zh: 你是从第几行开始想被问的？大概是什么让你在那一档翻了？
rationale_prompt.en: From which row did you start wanting to be asked? What made you switch there?

title.zh: β · 研究方向的兴趣权重
title.en: β · Interest weight across research directions

prompt.zh: 同样是「这条线还有进展」，如果它属于你更在意的方向，你会更愿意让它继续跑。下面每一题，请选你更想先看到结果的那个方向。
prompt.en: The same amount of progress matters more on a direction you care about. For each pair, pick the direction whose results you would rather see first.

hint.zh: 让一个已有方案跑得更快、更省、更准
hint.en: Make an existing solution faster, cheaper, or more accurate

label.zh: AI 模型行为与可靠性

hint.zh: 模型会不会幻觉、偏见、失真，以及怎么测出来
hint.en: Whether models hallucinate, are biased or miscalibrated, and how to measure it

hint.zh: 弄清某个自然/物理/生化机制，或设计能验证它的实验
hint.en: Work out a natural, physical or biochemical mechanism, or design an experiment for it

hint.zh: 谁在做、盘子多大、趋势往哪走
hint.en: Who is doing it, how big the market is, where the trend goes

hint.zh: 人、制度、文化、历史怎么运作和演变
hint.en: How people, institutions, culture and history work and change

sections.mapping: Bradley-Terry 拟合：P(i胜j)=π_i/(π_i+π_j)，MM 迭代 + 每对 0.5 伪计数（防 10 次比较下的 separation），π 归一到几何均值 1 即方向权重；循环三元组数作为一致性检查一并导出。

rationale_prompt.zh: 排在最前面的那个方向，为什么你最想先看？
rationale_prompt.en: The direction you ranked first — why do you most want to see it?

prompt.zh: 在一个节点上，你可以继续一条已经稳定出小结果的线，也可以跳到一个大胆的新假设。赌成了的收获约是小增量的 4 倍，赌输就一无所获、白花预算。下面每一行赌线的成功概率不同，请选你更愿意的做法。
prompt.en: At a node you can continue a line that reliably yields a small gain, or jump to a bold new hypothesis. If the gamble pays off it is worth about 4× the small gain; if not, nothing. The success probability changes each row — pick what you would rather do.

optionA.zh: 稳：继续那条稳定出小结果的线，基本确定拿到一个小增量
optionA.en: Safe: continue the steady line, near-certain small gain

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，20% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，80% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 20% chance of ~4× the gain, 80% nothing

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，35% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，65% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 35% chance of ~4× the gain, 65% nothing

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，50% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，50% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 50% chance of ~4× the gain, 50% nothing

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，65% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，35% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 65% chance of ~4× the gain, 35% nothing

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，80% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，20% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 80% chance of ~4× the gain, 20% nothing

optionB.zh: 赌：跳到新假设，90% 概率拿到约 4 倍的收获，10% 一无所获
optionB.en: Bold: jump to the new hypothesis — 90% chance of ~4× the gain, 10% nothing

sections.mapping: Holt-Laury 读法：翻转行经 CRRA 闭式 r = 1 − ln(1/p*)/ln 4 折成风险系数区间，点估计取区间中点。闸门侧 δ = 0.15 + 0.227·r（风险中性正好落在冻结默认 δ=0.15 上；PROVISIONAL），区间与中点保留在导出里。

rationale_prompt.zh: 你在哪一档愿意开始赌？是被成功概率说服的，还是本来就偏保守/偏激进？
rationale_prompt.en: At which row did you start taking the bet? Were you convinced by the probability, or are you just naturally cautious / bold?

prompt.zh: 下面这些操作按「做了以后有多难收回」从低到高排。哪些必须先经过你批准，agent 才能做？请全部勾出来。
prompt.en: These actions are ordered by how hard they are to undo. Which ones must be approved by you before the agent may do them? Tick all that apply.

label.zh: 删除一个中间缓存文件（可重新生成）
覆盖上一版实验结果文件
label.en: Overwrite the previous version of a results file

label.zh: 启动一个会花掉大部分剩余预算的大实验
label.en: Launch a big experiment that eats most of the remaining budget

label.zh: 修改共享代码库 / 提交到主分支
label.en: Modify the shared codebase / commit to the main branch

label.zh: 调用要花钱的外部 API
把结论对外发布（发报告 / 提交 / 对外通信）
label.en: Publish conclusions externally (report, submission, outbound message)

sections.mapping: 勾选的最低 rank = α 阈值 = 门0 的 M4 触发线：这一档及以上必须先问，以下 agent 自己做。

rationale_prompt.zh: 你划线的那一档，是什么让你觉得「从这里开始必须问我」？
rationale_prompt.en: At the line you drew — what makes you feel it must be asked from there on?

provisional_note.zh: ⚠ 五个参数里只有这个还没有现成测法。这是占位问法，以后可能整体换成行为式题目。
provisional_note.en: ⚠ This is the one parameter with no established elicitation method. This is a placeholder and may be replaced with a behavioural item later.

prompt.zh: 一棵典型的探索树大约有 20 个决策节点（这个数字是量出来的：FireBench 96 棵树的节点数中位数 18，ADRS 20 棵是 23）。整棵树跑完，你最多愿意被打断几次？
prompt.en: A typical exploration tree has about 20 decision nodes (measured: median 18 across 96 FireBench trees, 23 across 20 ADRS trees). Over one whole tree, how many times at most are you willing to be interrupted?

sections.mapping: 答案 ÷ 20 = 门2 的移交配额比例。现行 provisional 配额 ⌈5%⌉ 在 20 节点的树上 = 1 次。

rationale_prompt.zh: 你给的这个次数，是按什么估出来的？
rationale_prompt.en: How did you arrive at that number?
